_doc: How a life goes (design/lives/lives-and-carryover-spec.md §3–4; build items N-1.2, N-1.3). endings: the causes that end a life (any calamity:<id> does too): the Eclipse, turning back the Hours at a shrine (turned), the build-end card and the first playable's end card; every other lost fight or story loss wakes you injured instead. turning_needs_calamity: the Hours can be turned back only once a calamity has passed in this life. insight: +1 at each Turning up to cap; each point adds per to all Practice gained. wake_injured: days that pass (wild_days if you fell on a map marked wild), the share of Vitality you can hold until your next full night's sleep, and the extra wind-up on the first spell of each fight while Injured.
